theoryOfChange: Rebuilding Alliance seeks to realize a just and enduring peace in Palestine and Israel founded upon equal rights, equal security, and equal opportunity.  We help Palestinian families hold on to their homes, schools, and communities through community-directed construction and development programs  and grassroots and diplomatic advocacy especially in the U.S.  We work to ease trauma, build trust, strengthen peacemakers, advance law, and press policy-makers forward in tangible ways.

rich_narrative.summary: Rebuilding Alliance is dedicated to advancing equal rights for Palestinians through education, advocacy, and emergency direct aid [1]. The organization operates in the Gaza Strip, the West Bank, and Jerusalem to protect communities and support family livelihoods [11]. In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="14">$4,309,990 in total revenue</cite>, reflecting a rapid expansion in funding driven by noncash humanitarian donations [14]. Their direct assistance initiatives have previously distributed <cite id="3">27,000 solar-powered lanterns to children in Gaza</cite> [3]. However, severe financial health indicators limit the organization's overall operational stability. In FY2023, the organization reported total assets of <cite id="5">$74,521 against liabilities of $276,759</cite>, leading to critical cash flow deficits [5]. The organization maintains a <cite id="14">Program expense ratio of 93.3%</cite> in FY2024, directing most outlays toward direct program execution, though financial risks remain significant [14].
